title: encelia sanguinea
intro: Encelia sanguinea, commonly known as Red Stem Encelia or Red Stem Bush Sunflower, is a flowering plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the relief of inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Encelia sanguinea are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have shown antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. These constituents contribute to the plant's potential use in treating various health conditions, including infections, skin issues, and digestive problems.
